title: Rows for record equality
statement: For a natural number $k$, a symbol type $[0m\Gamma$ with decidable equality, and an index of one of four forms—comparison with $j<k+3$, forward pass with $j<k+2$ and $i<2$, backward pass with a Boolean flag, $j<k+2$ and $i<2$, or verdict with a Boolean flag—define a two-work-tape Turing machine whose state type is the phase type assigned to that index. The comparison indices use the machine that compares tapes $0$ and $1$; forward indices use a skip machine with parameter $i$; backward indices use a backward-skip machine with parameter $i$; and verdict indices use a skip machine with parameter $0$.
